hero.name: Ghassen Bargougui
hero.title: Application Engineer
hero.headline: Java Applications, Cloud & Platform Engineering
hero.tagline: I build and modernize Java applications and the cloud platforms they run on. At Rakuten, I work on financial systems across application development, cloud migration, performance testing, and observability.

paragraphs: I am an Application Engineer with seven years of Java and full-stack experience across Tunisia, Luxembourg, and Japan. My work spans banking, insurance, and card payments, from understanding business requirements and designing APIs to deploying applications and investigating performance issues.

At Rakuten, I help lead cloud migration work alongside my manager and project manager, coordinating with development, infrastructure, CI/CD, and security teams. I design application and infrastructure changes, validate deployments, investigate performance bottlenecks, and improve logging. I also automate local builds and deployments so teammates can get their development environments running more easily.

Outside work, I build products end to end: Slide Agent, an open-source engine for generating editable PowerPoint presentations; Pockito, an app for personal and shared finances; and SubMate, a Chrome extension for subtitle translation.
about.profile: Application Engineer with seven years of Java and full-stack experience in banking, insurance, and card payments across Tunisia, Luxembourg, and Japan. Build and modernize services, design APIs, and deliver cloud deployments. Combine hands-on development with performance analysis, delivery automation, and coordination across engineering teams.

experience.description: Develop financial applications and cloud infrastructure. Help lead cloud migration alongside my manager and project manager, coordinating across engineering teams.
achievements: Modernized Java services, resolved dependency and compatibility issues, updated tests, and documented the handover.
Design and validate cloud deployments, including networking, resource configuration, and fallback plans, with infrastructure and security teams.
Run performance tests with k6 and JMeter, investigate bottlenecks, and improve application design or resource allocation based on the results.
Improve structured application logging and trace handling to support monitoring and troubleshooting.
Develop Java APIs and service integrations, including session management and communication between application components.
Automated local builds and deployments to make development environment setup repeatable and easier for teammates.
Build CI/CD pipelines and work with partner teams to resolve deployment and connectivity issues, review designs, and support reliable delivery.

experience.assignment: Client assignment at BGL BNP Paribas
experience.description: Developed and maintained retail-banking applications on assignment at BGL BNP Paribas.
achievements: Implemented customer mandate workflows, from Spring Batch processing to Angular Material screens, with Spring Boot services.
Developed REST APIs and persistence layers with Hibernate, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.
Automated builds and deployments with Maven and Jenkins; maintained unit tests, SonarQube checks, and peer code reviews.

experience.description: Developed full-stack web applications and modernized Java services using Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL.
achievements: Refactored monolithic application components into microservices.
Built and documented REST APIs for service integration, including API versioning and security requirements.
Automated deployments with Jenkins and Docker, reducing manual release steps.

experience.description: Progressed from Software Developer to Analyst Developer, combining backend development for insurance and financial applications with requirements analysis and solution design.
achievements: Translated business requirements into backend designs and API contracts with business, architecture, and framework teams.
Improved API response times through query optimization and caching.
Documented solutions with UML and sequence diagrams and coordinated design decisions across teams.
Implemented authentication and role-based access control with Keycloak; maintained CI/CD pipelines and rollback procedures.

projects.title: Insurance Workflow Modernization
projects.summary: Insurance workflow modernization with Camunda BPM.
outcomes: Led the migration of insurance workflows to a Camunda BPM-based architecture to reduce manual processing.
Conducted functional analysis and client workshops, and implemented multithreaded batch processing.
Integrated ActiveMQ to automate bulk-processing workflows.

projects.title: Insurance Product Configuration
outcomes: Built insurance product configuration APIs and refactored legacy code for maintainability.
Profiled Java execution and memory usage with JProfiler and optimized the identified bottlenecks.

projects.title: Insurance Broker Portals
outcomes: Developed Angular interfaces and Java backend services for insurance brokers.
Integrated Keycloak single sign-on and BPMN-driven user flows.

projects.title: Document & Form Processing
projects.summary: Document and digital form processing for insurance workflows.
outcomes: Built Java services for document processing, using ActiveMQ for bulk event flows.
Integrated Keycloak authorization and analyzed Java heap usage with JProfiler.

projects.title: Insurance Pricing
projects.summary: Insurance product pricing and premium calculation.
outcomes: Developed product configuration and premium calculation features with client-side validation.
Processed Excel pricing templates with Apache POI to improve data integration.

projects.title: Slide Agent
projects.summary: Open-source toolkit for generating editable PowerPoint presentations from code and AI tools.
outcomes: Built a TypeScript engine that generates native PowerPoint charts, tables, themes, and embedded fonts from structured layouts.
Implemented font-based text measurement, layout and contrast checks, and offline OOXML validation.
Published @slide-agent/core on npm with a CLI, library API, and MCP server; added CSV-based template filling.

projects.title: Pockito
projects.summary: Personal and shared finance app with mobile and web clients.
outcomes: Built Flutter and Nuxt clients backed by Spring Boot, sharing business logic across REST and MCP interfaces.
Integrated Keycloak authentication, OAuth discovery for MCP clients, and event-driven notifications with Redis Streams.
Built Kubernetes deployment and rollback automation, with automated tests and end-to-end release checks.

projects.title: SubMate
projects.summary: Chrome extension for subtitle translation on Netflix, TVer, and Prime Video, with on-device and optional cloud translation.
outcomes: Implemented on-device translation and local caching with Chrome’s Translator API, without a dedicated backend or user accounts.
Designed a shared subtitle-processing core with platform adapters and synchronized fullscreen overlays.
Added optional cloud providers using the user’s API key and localized the interface in English, Japanese, French, and Arabic, with right-to-left support.

projects.title: Orbit Ways
projects.summary: Browser-based multiplayer strategy board game with real-time game state over WebSockets.
outcomes: Built Spring Boot session, game-state, and matchmaking services with WebSocket updates and an Angular/Ionic interface.
Containerized the application with Docker behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

projects.title: Traffic Forward
projects.summary: Spring Boot HTTP forwarding tool with configurable routing and request/response diagnostics.
outcomes: Implemented HTTP forwarding with YAML routes supporting exact paths, variables, and wildcards while preserving request data.
Added request/response logging with timing and body previews, and packaged the service for Docker Compose.
